faq.a: Turan is associated with the Persian form تُورَان, whose core sense is turan; the land of tur (persian).

faq.q: What is the origin of Turan?
faq.a: Turan is associated with Persian. Turan is Persian توران (Tūrān), a historical region name, used as a male given name.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Turan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Turan should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Tūrān is a Persian place name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.a: In Persian, Turan is rendered توران and carries the sense توران، توران.

faq.q: What are the variants of Turan?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Turan, turan. Script forms are توران, تُورَان, तुरान.

faq.q: Is Turan a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
